human_review_text: This paper develops a new algorithm for the logistic regression problem, which can provably achieve much faster directional convergence compared to GD and NGD. The key idea is to progressively rescale the model parameter at a proper rate to maintain a non-degenerate centripetal velocity. Finally, the margin maximization rate can be improved.
